backupPath.label: uBlock Origin backup file
backupPath.description: Full path to a backup exported from uBO's dashboard (Settings -> Backup to file). Its selected filter lists, My filters and trusted sites replace this addon's built-in defaults. Leave empty to keep the defaults.

syncOnStartup.label: Re-read the backup on every start
syncOnStartup.description: Picks up a freshly exported backup without opening this page. Turn off to sync only when you press Sync Now.
